text:
anya: Heads-up: hit a nasty case with the offload preemptor yesterday. Large pinned KV was preempted mid-evict and the page ended up marked resident but pointer cleared. Repro steps in reply.

miguel: ugh. can you paste logs?

anya: logs: `offload: preempt request id=314159 evict_batch=42` then `reclaim: missing-ref on slot 0x7f...`

sasha: is this the same as the "preempt then rollback" race we discussed in rfc? we added a safety-bump but maybe not enough.

kevin: we implemented bump as atomic bump counter on lease. but if preemptor dies before ack, bump stays and later regrant thinks bumped.

irene: suggestion: add a two-phase rollback: Preemptor -> mark PENDING_ROLLBACK -> wait for lease-owners to ack -> commit rollback -> cleanup. pseudo:

```text
if preempt: set(state=PENDING_ROLLBACK)
notify(all holders)
wait(timeout)
if any holder ack==NACK: abort and fallback
else commit: clear refs, inc epoch
```

anya: that looks ok. How do we avoid O(n) wait on hot tenants?

miguel: piggyback ack on normal lease-heartbeat. if no ack after TTL, background sweeper increments epoch and forces reclaim. also track minimal ack count to avoid waiting for stragglers.

sasha: add metrics: rollback_latency, orphaned_pages_count, rollback_aborts

kevin: implementation notes: need to update allocator API: `reserve_lease(epoch)` returns (ok|stale) and `ack_rollback(id)` RPC. Fallback: if stale, caller must re-request memory.

anya: can we do graceful fallback in the runtime to re-run micro-batches instead of dropping inference?

irene: yes, runtime can catch `LeaseStale` and schedule microbatch retry, with backoff.

anya: ok I'll open follow-up RFC for lease v2 with the two-phase rollback + metrics + runtime retry. Will ping infra-bot for svc account.

evictor-bot: created issue #4521: "lease-v2: two-phase rollback protocol" assigned to @anya.

miguel: thanks. also add test for preemptor crash during commit. corner case.

anya: noted. will include unit + integration tests simulating crash and slow ack.

kevin: one more: ensure we don't double-free on replay; add idempotent commit markers with monotonic commit counter.

sasha: :thumbsup:
